svg.text: Private residence — rear courtyard (site address to be inserted)
1. Do not scale from this drawing. Use figured dimensions only.
2. All dimensions in millimetres; levels in metres relative to internal FFL
±0.000 (datum to be tied to site survey).
3. Contractor to verify all dimensions, levels & existing structure on site
4. Read with all other architectural, structural & services drawings and the
5. Structural members are preliminary: final design, connections &
calculations by a licensed structural engineer to local code before
6. Report any discrepancy to the designer before proceeding.
CONSTRUCTION ISSUE — subject to site survey & local engineer sign-off
Soffit: 68x20 thermo-ash slats, 10 mm gaps, run E-W,
LED strip 24 V DC, 14.4 W/m, 2700 K, CRI ≥ 90, IP67, in 25x20 recessed alu profile, opal diffuser, mitred corners
Recessed soffit downlight, 7 W LED, 2700 K, 36°, IP65, Ø68 cut-out, black trim
Wall sconce up/down, 2 x 4 W, 2700 K, IP54, bronze, c/l +2.100
Spike spotlight 12 V, 3 W, 2700 K, 40°, IP67, adjustable, bronze; 1 m cable to junction box
Twin switched socket 16 A, IP66 weatherproof, RCD 30 mA, on E wall +0.450
LED drivers: 2 x 100 W 24 V constant voltage (DALI/phase-cut dimmable) + 60 W 12 V for UL
Astronomical time-switch + scene dimmer (dusk-on, 23:30 50%, off 01:00), smart-home ready
1. New circuits from existing consumer unit: C1 lighting (RCBO 6 A, 30 mA, Type A); C2 external socket (RCBO
16 A, 30 mA). Installer to verify capacity, earthing & bonding.
2. All external work to IEC 60364-7-714 / local wiring regulations; certificate on completion.
3. LV cables: 1.5 mm² H07RN-F in 20 mm conduit inside canopy void; through façade in sleeved hole, sealed. 12
V garden cable in 25 mm flexible duct 300 deep in planter.
4. Driver location must be ventilated & accessible (utility, behind lattice door D03).
5. Voltage drop on LS1 < 3%: feed from 2 points (NE corner & mid-front via void).
6. Install draw-wires before soffit slats are fixed; test & label all circuits.
